minutes.headline: Select Board appointed three to Conservation Commission and allowed a community vigil at TC Passios.
minutes.summary: The board heard public comment, held a Unitil pole hearing, approved a charity 5K road race, and interviewed five Conservation Commission candidates before appointing three on a split vote on one. It debated the process and purpose of a community vigil and resolution, then authorized use of TC Passios. It also made annual appointments, assigned liaisons, and heard the town manager's report.

what_happened.line: The Select Board appointed three people to the Conservation Commission after interviewing five candidates; one reappointment passed 3-2 as counted by the chair.
The board authorized use of TC Passios for a community vigil on Friday at 6:30, after debating its process and purpose.
The town manager said the vigil falls under her authority rather than being a town-sponsored event, though the board then voted.
The board approved a Unitil pole petition and a charity 5K road race at Lake Whalom on June 18, with the police chief's consent.
The town manager's report relayed the state budget and aid outlook and a retirement COLA bill that could raise the town's assessment.

why_it_matters: The Conservation Commission rules on wetlands and development permits, so its membership shapes how those applications are reviewed.
State aid and a retirement COLA bill both bear on the town's budget and, through it, on tax bills, though neither was acted on here.
watch_next: A townwide email soliciting goal suggestions ahead of the board's goals workshop.
An executive session requested for the end of the next meeting about a school-related site visit.
